_doc: Wolf packs (ADR-0055, WildlifeDef kind `pack`): planned like the herds (WildlifeSpawner, per 128 m cell, day and time of day; density = packs per km² at biome weight 1) in the deep woods and the burn, and spawned as `enemy` bodies (an Enemy of faction wildlife) by WolfPacks, group = the pack's size. The `wolves` world setting turns them off; data/config/wolves.json holds the pack's tuning.

defs.name: Grey Wolves
defs.description: A pack of three to six, ranging the conifer woods and the burn after deer.
